verdict.rationale: Apple's macOS page describes a built-in Siri AI that can take actions in apps such as Messages, Music and Reminders. It can also act on what is on screen, draft or critique writing, and hold persistent conversations, so users can hand tasks to an assistant inside the OS. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the action-taking, documentation of multi-step autonomous delegation, and the full scope of supported apps and actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Siri AI can take actions in apps like Messages, Music, Reminders, and more based on what you’re doing in the moment.
Just take a screenshot of what’s on your display, like an image or a PDF, to get answers, search, or take action.
Siri AI can now generate a draft from scratch or provide feedback on what you’ve written. Just describe what you need in your own words.
Quickly edit a message you just sent or add a song from a show you’re watching to your workout playlist.
